name: smart-employee-management-system
description: Smart Employee Management System — MERN stack

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix server && npm run lint --prefix client
scripts.test: npm test --prefix server && npm test --prefix client
